posts.title: Urban stays in Madrid and a hotel in Asturias: how we like to travel
posts.excerpt: Why we choose stays with character and how Hello Group looks after every detail.
body: An urban hotel or a rural stay is more than sleeping elsewhere: it is a change of pace and the feeling of home away from home.
Hello Group brings together distinctive stays — Astur, Canillas, Mediterraneo, Madrid Norte and Sincelejo — under the same warm hospitality.
If you want a getaway with character, start by choosing the home that fits your plan and tell us what you need.

posts.title: Travelling with a pet: what to keep in mind
posts.excerpt: Practical tips for a stress-free pet-friendly escape for you and your four-legged companion.
body: Travelling with a pet works best with a little planning: tell us when you book, bring their bed or blanket, and respect each home’s house rules.
Our pet-friendly stays are meant so nobody is left out of the plan. If you have questions about outdoor space or rules, write to us before you arrive.

posts.title: A weekend in Asturias
posts.excerpt: Hiking, coast and good food around Hello Astur.
body: Asturias invites you to mix mountains and sea within a short drive. From Hello Astur you can plan trails, nearby beaches and local food worth the stop.
Leave room to do nothing: often the best plan is simply staying in.
